# Repo-owned GLM source snapshot

This is the pinned [g-truc/glm](https://github.com/g-truc/glm) source at commit `0af55ccecd98d4e5a8d1fad7de25ba429d60e863`, previously a Git submodule of Enroth Continuum. The original 1,662 tracked files are retained without source edits. The full upstream `copying.txt`, including its MIT license option, remains here. This file is Enroth Continuum provenance metadata, not part of the upstream snapshot.

The current Mac MM7 target uses GLM. Owning this source removes its submodule fetch, but does not resolve the other MM7 build inputs or make a clean offline build possible.
